quote: Invenergy … announced commercial operations have commenced on its landmark high-voltage Tealov Cardal transmission line in Uruguay … Cardal consists of a new 55-kilometer (34-mile), 500 kV high-voltage transmission line, a new 20-kilometer (12-mile), 150 kV transmission line, a new 500 kV substation, and accompanying infrastructure. … The line is operated by … UTE … under a 30-year lease agreement. … Invenergy in partnership with IDB Invest … financed the construction under an innovative A/B Bond structure
